summary: LUNAVIA visual-fidelity pass validation. Full mission flow e2e-tested on live preview URL end-to-end: landing (/) → /mission control room → LAUNCH SEQUENCE → 10s countdown → ASCENT cinematic → STAGE SEPARATION (btn-separate) → SEP_DONE cinematic → CISLUNAR CRUISE → LUNAR ORBIT (btn-descend enabled 'GO FOR PDI') → DifficultySelect (CADET/ASTRONAUT/COMMANDER) → PdiBriefing (CADET · PDI READY card w/ BEGIN PDI) → Manual descent (DescentGame with full HUD: altitude/vspeed/hspeed/tilt/throttle/fuel + lander on terrain + flight controls). Verified 0 console errors across full run. All 4 rebuilt/reworked components render cleanly with no WebGL exceptions.

landing_hero_earth_moon.evidence: Earth is lit (blue oceans, continents, cloud layer, atmospheric limb glow), rocket + trajectory arc visible, Moon shown as crescent — matches spec, no regression.

ascent_gradient_sky.evidence: SEP_PROMPT screenshot shows detailed multi-stage LV-001 rocket (orange band, dark interstage, black band, upper stage w/ orange nozzle, escape tower + spike) against gradient sky (dark blue near bottom → black at top). No visible ignition dust ring on this frame because it's already high-altitude (progress≈0.35).

ignition_sequence.evidence: Countdown ran 10s, rocket transitioned to ascent, reached SEP_PROMPT after ~4s. No console errors, canvas rendered (not black), rocket visible.

stage_separation_gradual_drift_tumble.evidence: 03b_sep_done_late.jpeg shows stage 1 drifting away at an angle (tumbling — visibly rotated ~30° off vertical) and lagging below/behind stage 2 which continues upward with a soft translucent blue vacuum plume. Stage 1 did NOT vanish or drop straight down — behaves exactly per spec (rate 0.22, ~4.5s).

cislunar_cruise_earth_lit.evidence: 04_cruise_early.jpeg shows Earth prominently LIT (blue oceans, Africa continent visible, white cloud layer, terminator glow) with the CSM spacecraft in foreground (cone + interstage + solar panels). Not a black disc. Deep-space starfield visible around Earth.

lunar_orbit_moon_terminator.evidence: 05_orbit.jpeg shows Moon with dramatic terminator (crescent-lit right side, dark shadowed left half), craters visible on lit portion, spacecraft silhouette on far right, INITIATE DESCENT button present with 'OVER LANDING ZONE — GO FOR PDI' (btn-descend enabled after 1s of orbit).

pdi_briefing_card_appears.evidence: PdiBriefing renders correctly after difficulty pick: 'CADET · PDI READY' heading, mission objective text, CONTROLS panel (keyboard mapping ↑/←→/SPACE/A/D/Q/E/C/P), SAFE TOUCHDOWN limits (vy≤4.5, vx≤4, tilt≤22°), ENTRY STATE (alt 400m, fuel 200kg, vy 4.0m/s, vx 2.0m/s), BEGIN PDI button + CHANGE DIFFICULTY link. First-ever runtime validation of this component.

manual_descent_hud_and_controls.evidence: DescentGame loads with all HUD testids present (gauge-altitude/vspeed/hspeed/tilt, throttle-cmd, descent-profile, descent-guidance, projected-lz, ctrl-throttle/left/right, view-external/cockpit/nav, descent-abort/pause). Lander visible on lunar terrain, HUD reads altitude 389m / vspeed -7.1 m/s / hspeed 2.0 / fuel 100%. Thrust key (ArrowUp held 3s) executed without exception — game running.

console_errors.evidence: 0 console errors and 0 page errors captured across the full ~90s automated run.

critical_code_review_comments: Mission.jsx dt cap of 0.1s effectively works — under headless throttling the SPACE (cruise) phase advances slowly but does complete; validated it reaches ORBIT within ~60s of wall time as expected. Good defensive coding.
PdiBriefing gating (Phase 2) works cleanly: DIFFICULTY → BRIEFING → MANUAL_DESCENT, with orbit MissionScene kept as background in both DIFFICULTY and BRIEFING states — nice continuity.
No _id serialization concerns since backend is not exercised on this path.

Minor observation (not blocking): 02_ascent_sep_prompt.jpeg was captured at progress=0.35 (i.e. exactly at SEP_PROMPT gate) so the pad-level ignition flash / lateral smoke billows described in the spec aren't visible in that particular frame — the ascent phase transitions past pad quickly (~4s). A test hook or slower initial ramp would help capture pad-level VFX in future automated tests. Visually verified rocket art and gradient sky are correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full mission flow is stable on https://lunar-journey-3.preview.emergentagent.com/mission. Timing under headless: countdown+ascent→SEP_PROMPT ~4-6s, SEP_DONE→SPACE ~5-6s, SPACE→ORBIT ~20-40s (dt cap 0.1s + 30000/s ratio), ORBIT btn-descend enables within 1-3s once overLandingZone fires. To capture pad-level ignition VFX (vapor/flash/smoke billows), take screenshots WHILE the countdown is running or immediately at ASCENT state with progress<0.05 — do not wait for SEP_PROMPT. All data-testids used: mission-page, btn-separate, btn-descend, difficulty-cadet, descent-game, gauge-*, ctrl-*, descent-abort, descent-pause, view-external/cockpit/nav. PdiBriefing has no dedicated testid on the BEGIN button — find by text 'BEGIN PDI'.
